Hao’s feat of reporting took a series of twists and turns over the coming months, eventually revealing how OpenAI’s ambition had taken it far afield from its original mission. ## Boomers, doomers, and Altman

Hao contextualizes the struggles within OpenAI as an ideological conflict between _Boomers_ (AI accelerationists) and _Doomers_ (AI safety advocates). Specifically, many Doomers were concerned about having Sam Altman as the leader of the company that ushers in artificial general intelligence (AGI), especially due to his marginalization of the safety and alignment concerns.
